_doc: Sistema de prompts para generación de imágenes de referencia de cortes masculinos. Diseñado para fal.ai FLUX Kontext Pro (edición de foto real) y para FLUX text-to-image (referencia genérica). Estética: Instagram barbería premium española.

modos.modo_kontext: FLUX Kontext: recibe la foto del cliente + instrucción. Transforma el pelo del cliente real. Usar para el virtual try-on personalizado.
modos.modo_text_to_image: FLUX text-to-image: genera una imagen de referencia de un hombre con la forma facial del cliente. Usar como 'foto de inspiración' cuando no hay foto real.

angulos.frontal: Vista de frente. Muestra el tope, el flequillo, las proporciones. Iluminación de estudio, fondo neutro.
angulos.tres_cuartos_izquierda: Perfil 45° desde la izquierda. El ángulo más favorecedor. Muestra el fade lateral izquierdo y el tope simultáneamente.
angulos.tres_cuartos_derecha: Perfil 45° desde la derecha. Muestra el fade lateral derecho, la nuca, la transición.

kontext_instructions._doc: Instrucciones para FLUX Kontext (edición de foto real). La foto del cliente es el input. El texto describe qué cambiar.

template_base.estructura: Keep the person's face, skin tone, eyes, and facial structure exactly identical. Change ONLY the hairstyle to: {cut_name}. Barbershop technique: {technique}. Result must look like a professional barbershop portfolio photo. Do not change clothing, facial hair, or background. {angle_suffix}

campos.cut_name: Nombre técnico en inglés del corte (nombre_en del catálogo)
campos.technique: Descripción técnica concisa (máx 250 chars) del catálogo spain_trends
campos.angle_suffix: Instrucción de ángulo de cámara (ver abajo)

angle_suffixes.frontal: Camera angle: straight-on frontal view, subject looking directly at camera. Passport-style portrait lighting. Clean neutral background.
angle_suffixes.three_quarter_left: Camera angle: 3/4 profile from the subject's left side, approximately 45 degrees. Left side of face and temple fade clearly visible. Professional barbershop editorial angle. Natural side lighting.
angle_suffixes.three_quarter_right: Camera angle: 3/4 profile from the subject's right side, approximately 45 degrees. Right side fade/taper clearly visible. Shows back hairline and neckline transition. Warm barbershop lighting.

guidance.nota: Para mayor fidelidad al corte: subir guidance_scale a 4.0-4.5. Para mayor fidelidad a la cara: bajar a 3.0. El balance actual (3.5) es el óptimo.

haircut_descriptions._doc: Plantillas de descripción técnica. Keys ALINEADOS con haircut_aliases.json cut IDs para matching directo. Descripciones diseñadas para maximizar el contraste visual entre cortes.
haircut_descriptions.low_fade_textured: low fade with textured top: sides with a LOW TAPER FADE starting just above the ear (not to skin), gradual blend upward. Top has 5-7cm of TEXTURED choppy hair, piece-y and matte-finished. The low fade preserves some weight at the temples, creating a natural transition. Defined neckline. The texture on top is directional and intentional, not messy.
haircut_descriptions.bro_flow: bro flow / medium-length men's hair: LONGER hair (10-15cm) swept back and to the sides with NATURAL MOVEMENT, no rigid hold. Hair flows over and behind the ears. NO fade, NO undercut — full length retained on sides. Slight layering for movement. Relaxed, effortless surfer-meets-rockstar aesthetic. The hair has visible wave and bounce.
haircut_descriptions.french_crop_fade: French crop with fade: FLAT HORIZONTAL FRINGE approximately 2-3cm long sitting just above eyebrows, squared off bluntly like a shelf. Top is SHORT and flat (2-3cm), no height at all. Sides with low to mid taper fade. Squared neckline. Completely flat top — zero vertical volume.
haircut_descriptions.modern_mullet: modern mullet haircut: SHORT FADE at the sideburns area, tight and clean around the temples. Medium textured top. The fade is compact and localized at the patillas/sideburns, not an all-over skin fade. The back retains more length than a standard fade but the defining feature is the short sideburn fade creating contrast with the textured top and longer back.
haircut_descriptions.pompadour_fade: modern pompadour with fade: hair swept dramatically UP and BACK from forehead creating a high forward-pointing wave (8-10cm height at front), sides faded (low to mid), structured with pomade. The front section stands tall — an exaggerated swept-up shape clearly different from a quiff.
haircut_descriptions.taper_fade: classic taper fade: natural flowing hair (6-7cm on top), sides gently tapered but NOT faded to skin — short but still visible hair throughout. No harsh contrast. Clean, understated, traditional. The sides retain some hair all the way down. Professional, office-appropriate look.
haircut_descriptions.librito_fade: middle part cut (librito) with fade: hair parted DOWN THE CENTER creating two symmetrical curtains falling to each side (8-10cm), with a LOW FADE on the sides below the curtains. The center parting is clean and defined. Hair flows forward and outward from the part. Relaxed but groomed aesthetic.
haircut_descriptions.skin_fade: skin fade haircut: sides shaved to skin-bare at temples (zero guard), blending upward to a SHORT MESSY textured top approximately 4-5cm. Key visual: extreme contrast between bare-skin sides and choppy, piece-y texture on top. No volume, no height — just horizontal texture. Defined neckline.
haircut_descriptions.high_fade: high fade haircut: sides faded very HIGH near temples creating maximum clean contrast, top hair (5-7cm) with texture or volume. The fade starts high on the head — above the temple line — creating a striking silhouette. Clean geometric neckline.
haircut_descriptions.mid_fade: mid fade haircut: sides faded starting at MID-EAR level, creating a balanced silhouette. Top approximately 5-7cm with textured or swept finish. The mid-fade is the most versatile — not as dramatic as high fade, not as subtle as low fade.
haircut_descriptions.wolf_shag: men's wolf cut / shag: LONG shaggy layered hair (10-14cm), no fade whatsoever on sides, curtain-like hair flowing down to jaw level on sides. Heavy layers throughout, messy voluminous crown, wispy ends, rockstar aesthetic. Completely opposite of a fade — full side-length retention.
haircut_descriptions.curtain_hair: men's curtain hair (middle part): hair flows DOWN naturally from a CENTER PART to both sides like curtains (10-12cm), reaching below the cheekbones. NO fade — full side length retained. Soft layers, natural relaxed movement. Long hair flowing down the sides of the face — zero short sides.
haircut_descriptions.burst_fade: burst fade: the fade goes AROUND the ear but DOES NOT reach the bottom of the nape — it stops after rounding the ear. The nape is then ROUNDED with a trimmer, creating a clean rounded neckline. The fade wraps the ear area only, not all the way down. Top retains full length (5-8cm). The key difference vs mohawk: the burst fade stops around the ear, the nape is trimmed round and clean.
haircut_descriptions.mohicano_fade: mohawk with fade: the fade goes DOWN AROUND THE EAR on both sides, leaving a VERTICAL STRIP of hair at the NAPE with fade on both sides of it. The back finish is normally POINTED (acabado en punta) but can also be ROUNDED. The fade wraps around the ear and descends, creating the mohawk shape from the back view — a central vertical line of hair with clean faded sides tapering to a point at the nape.
haircut_descriptions.drop_fade: drop fade: the fade line DROPS DOWN behind the ear, creating a curved arc that is higher at the temples and lower at the back. Top hair 5-7cm with texture. The drop creates a natural flow that follows the head shape. Clean neckline that curves with the drop.
haircut_descriptions.crew_cut: crew cut: similar to a French crop but SHORTER, similar to a buzz cut but LONGER. Hair is just long enough to lightly style/comb but too short to fall with weight. A step up from buzz — you can see direction in the hair and slightly shape it, but it's still very short and clean. Soft taper at temples and neckline.
haircut_descriptions.quiff_fade: textured quiff: the NORMAL everyday fringe/bangs but with added TEXTURE. Hair falls forward naturally over the forehead, piece-y and matte-finished with choppy textured ends. NOT swept up high — it's a standard-length fringe with textured styling. Sides with mid fade. The texture is the defining feature, not height or volume.
haircut_descriptions.buzz_cut: buzz cut: uniform ultra-short clipper cut all over top (3-6mm, barely any hair visible), soft taper at temples and neckline, minimal fade. Extremely clean and military-precise. Almost no hair on top — can see scalp clearly through the top.
haircut_descriptions.comb_over_fade: comb over with fade: top hair (6-8cm) combed neatly to ONE SIDE with a defined SIDE PART, creating a sleek directional sweep. Low to mid fade on the sides. Optional hard part (razor line). Classic, polished, professional barbershop look. The side part is the defining feature.
haircut_descriptions.undercut: undercut: ALL hair swept BACKWARDS from forehead to crown, slicked back. Sides with a MEDIUM-HIGH FADE. The defining feature is the direction — everything goes back, no fringe, no side parting. The fade on the sides is mid-to-high, clean and blended. Classic slick-back look with faded sides.
haircut_descriptions.natural_curls_fade: natural curly hair with fade: TIGHT CURLS on top (6-8cm), visible defined curl pattern throughout. Low to mid fade at sides blending into the curls. Curl definition product visible. The curly texture on top is the dominant feature — bouncy, defined ringlets contrasting with clean faded sides.
haircut_descriptions.edgar_cut: Edgar cut: a bold STRAIGHT HORIZONTAL FRINGE cut bluntly across the forehead at eyebrow level, creating a sharp geometric line. Sides with HIGH SKIN FADE to zero. The fringe is the signature — perfectly straight, heavy, and blunt. Top can be textured (fluffy edgar) or flat. Very clean, very urban, very intentional.
haircut_descriptions.blowout_fade: blowout fade: a variation of taper fade where MORE HAIR is LEFT TO FALL creating extra WEIGHT and TEXTURE. Viewed from the side, the back-top area has noticeably more bulk and texture than a standard taper. The difference vs normal taper: in a regular taper the fade line continues cleanly into the back with no extra weight; in a blowout the hair above the fade drops down with body and texture, generating visual weight behind and above the ear area. Heavier, fuller finish.
haircut_descriptions.tomahawk: tomahawk: a MIX of mohawk and burst fade. The fade ROUNDS ALL AROUND the ear fully. Normally with a WELL-DEFINED FRINGE (cerquillo bien marcado) at the front. The end of the fade sits at the BACK, BELOW the ear, almost at the nape. It combines the rounded ear fade of the burst with the vertical definition of the mohawk. The fringe and the back fade endpoint are the two signature elements.
haircut_descriptions.textured_crop: textured crop: short flat top (3-5cm) with TEXTURED choppy ends, piece-y and matte-finished. Fringe falls forward naturally just above the eyebrows. Low to mid fade on sides. No volume, no height — purely horizontal texture on a flat plane. Modern, minimal, low-maintenance.
haircut_descriptions._legacy_variants_doc: Variantes adicionales para matching en prompts de text-to-image genéricos:
haircut_descriptions.high_fade_hard_part: high fade with hard part: temples shaved to skin, defined RAZOR-CUT parting line etched into the hair on one side, top hair (7cm) combed flat to one side with pomade, sharp geometric neckline.
haircut_descriptions.zero_fade_beard: zero fade with connected beard: hair fades to zero at temples, blending seamlessly into medium beard (15-20 days, defined edges). Top approximately 5cm. Haircut and beard form ONE unified shape.
haircut_descriptions.slick_back_low_fade: slick back: hair (9-10cm) slicked COMPLETELY BACKWARDS from forehead with wet-look pomade, every strand swept away from the face, tight to the skull. Low fade at temples.
haircut_descriptions.disconnected_undercut: disconnected undercut with dramatic top volume: long flowing top (9-12cm) swept sideways, sides shaved nearly to skin with a HARD DISCONNECTION. The top hair OVERHANGS the sides dramatically.

quality_guidelines._titulo: Criterios de Calidad para Imágenes de Barbería Premium
quality_guidelines.referencia_instagram: Las mejores barberías de Instagram en España (TheCut BCN, Gentlemen's Club Madrid, Barber Shop Málaga) usan iluminación natural lateral o luz de ventana con fondo de madera oscura o ladrillo. El foco está siempre en la textura del corte.

criterios.iluminacion: Luz natural de ventana o luz suave de caja. Evitar flash directo. La textura del pelo debe verse con detalle.
criterios.angulo: El 3/4 izquierdo es el ángulo más usado en Instagram de barberías — muestra el fade Y el tope simultáneamente.
criterios.fondo: Madera oscura, ladrillo expuesto, o fondo neutro gris/blanco. Nada que distraiga del corte.
criterios.expresion: Cara seria o expresión neutral. No sonrisa. La foto es del corte, no del personaje.
criterios.ropa: Camiseta blanca o capa de barbería negra — no distraen del corte.
criterios.detalle: La textura, el fade, la transición de la nuca deben verse con nitidez absoluta.
